results.content: Nationally, 34 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 60 percent disapprove as of Friday, leaving him underwater with a net approval rating of -26, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. As of Saturday, the survey had garnered around 129,500 responses since January 20, 2025 when Trump was inaugurated for a second term.
